name: Agent Problem Solving
description: Keeps each agent on one written problem per thread: injects the register and a context gauge every turn, writes an append-only decision log, and ships frame/reframe/close/focus skills.

agents.description: Agent ids the hook runs for. Empty or absent means every agent.

overlayPath.description: Absolute path to the operator overlay holding registers, logs and the deny-list.

stateDir.description: Where snapshots and turn counts live. Defaults to <overlayPath>/.state.

registerFile.description: Register filename inside each agent overlay folder. Default PROBLEMS.md.

warnTokens.description: Offer a reset at the next problem boundary above this.

highTokens.description: Offer a reset straight away above this.

compactShrinksSession.description: Set true only on a backend where compacting shrinks the session.

resetCommand.description: The command the reset offer names. Default /new.
